settings.restartHowToContent:
Some settings (scheduling cadences, gateway listen ports, rate limit binding, XMLA session TTL, frontend proxy targets) take effect only when the affected service process restarts.

Docker compose deployments:
docker compose restart gateway
docker compose restart query-router
docker compose restart model-service
docker compose restart optimizer
docker compose restart scheduler

systemd / bare-process deployments: restart the corresponding unit, e.g. systemctl restart tessallite-gateway.

After the relevant service has restarted with the new value, click the button below to clear the pending list.
